summary: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting the passing of Lead Independent Director David Johnson on July 22, 2026, and subsequent board actions: the Board reduced its size from nine to eight members, elected Ralph Nicoletti as new Lead Independent Director, and appointed John Coldman to the Compensation and Nominating/Governance Committees. The filing is a routine corporate governance disclosure related to a director's death and board succession. No special-situation transaction, strategic review, or capital event is involved. This is not a forced management change or meeting notice; it is an ordinary 8-K event, so no special-situation category applies.
